name: spotlight-card2
blurb: Single spotlight card with title, description, and centered image.
description: A single Spotlight-wrapped card with centered image, heading, and multi-line description. Dark background; spotlight is static (no proximity tracking).
use_when: Feature highlights or product showcases where a single, centered card design creates focus and clarity.
avoid_when: Content-dense layouts where a single card might be insufficient.
a11y: Text is readable and semantic. Image is present. No motion effects beyond layout.
